_about: Trimmed from the S1-8-saturday part of revision 1 of the subway-timetables dataset as stored in skku_content and skku_content_dev on 2026-10-20 (each part hash-equal to its committed file at commit 7718b7c0), 48 of its 239 trains in their order: each train whose time at a served platform falls from 50 minutes before (10 where no tracker tick is pinned) to 90 minutes after a pinned instant of its day type (weekday 08:00 (the tick), 00:20 and 02:00 KST; Saturday 14:00; public holiday 11:00, and 14:00 for the Korail and Shinbundang holiday tables, which serve Saturdays), or from 10 minutes before to 30 minutes after an instant a unit or route test reads the tables at (weekday 18:13 to 18:17, 20:20 to 21:12 and 22:27 KST; Saturday 10:07 to 10:46 and 21:07). The part schema strips this note. Widened 2026-11-10 for 송파, 가락시장, 복정 (ADR 0017 D6): the table's stations now run on from 남위례 to the 모란 terminus, each train above is its widened row, and the source revision is the rebuild's. The trains whose time at one of those platforms falls from 50 minutes before to 90 minutes after a pinned instant of its day type (weekday 08:00, 00:20 and 02:00 KST; Saturday 14:00; public holiday 11:00, and 14:00 for the Korail and Shinbundang holiday tables, which serve Saturdays) are added, in the part's order.
